headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, while the Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2. The New York Yankees shut out the Chicago Cubs 2-0, and the Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 3-4.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the New York Mets placing Cionel Pérez on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain. The Tampa Bay Rays have also placed Shane McClanahan on the 15-day injured list with left mid-back tightness. The Chicago Cubs have placed Gavin Hollowell on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation, while the Minnesota Twins have transferred Cole Sands to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, with the Minnesota Twins acquiring A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for Bruin Agbayani and Billy Amick. The Detroit Tigers have traded Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for Zane Barnhart, and the Los Angeles Angels have traded Logan O'Hoppe and Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for Angel Arredondo.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers in a closely contested matchup. Jonny DeLuca led the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Steven Matz pitched 2 scoreless innings for the Rangers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Minnesota Twins in a closely contested matchup. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the game, but it wasn't enough to secure a win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with the White Sox securing the win.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, securing their win behind strong pitching and timely hitting. JJ Wetherholt led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 2-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren and Shota Imanaga leading the pitching effort. Amed Rosario, Spencer Jones, and Pedro Ramírez made significant contributions at the plate for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Mets Place Cionel Pérez on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Mets left-handed pitcher Cionel Pérez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain, retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Minter Joins Twins in Blockbuster Trade**
top_news.summary: A.J. Minter has been traded to the Minnesota Twins, marking a significant move for the left-handed pitcher. The New York Mets acquired SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick in the deal.
